original_value: A fictional 34-inch curved OLED desktop monitor designed for color-critical creative work and cinematic gaming. It features a 3440 x 1440 ultrawide panel, 240 Hz refresh rate, 0.03 ms response time, USB-C docking, and factory-calibrated wide-gamut color coverage. The display includes an adjustable stand, built-in KVM switching, and a low-blue-light mode for long editing sessions.
